text:
Aisha Patel: Quick sync — following the postmortem, we need final owners/timelines for alert tuning: dedupe, thresholds, and paging policy. Who can take what? :mag:
Ben K.: I can own dedupe. Plan: 2-week spike to identify noisy signatures, propose dedupe rules and suppression windows. Will need sample alerts export. :+1:
Carlos M.: I can take thresholds & signal pruning. Goal is to reduce false positives by tightening thresholds and pruning low-signal routes. Need per-alert noise rates (last 30d). @Evan L. can you share?
Evan L.: DevOncallBot just posted a summary, but I'll pull per-alert noise rates and drop them here by EOD. Quick preview: alert_group_api_5xx noise ~62% (false-positive), alert_db_conn spikes 45% mostly infra flapping.
DevOncallBot: Automated summary: 7d window: 42 unique alerts, 118 total triggers, top noisy alerts: alert_group_api_5xx (62%), alert_cache_miss_flood (53%). See /alerts/summary?range=7d
Aisha Patel: Thanks — assigning owners: Ben -> dedupe; Carlos -> thresholds/pruning; I'll own paging policy doc (escalation windows + oncall burden reduction). Tentative timelines: proposals by Tue next week, implementation start after review.
Ben K.: Confirmed. I'll run a sweep script to group alert signatures and output candidate dedupe rules. Example command I'm starting with:
```bash
# export alerts for last 30 days
./tools/alert-export --group alert_group_api_5xx --range 30d --format json > api_5xx.json
```
Ben K.: Then I'll run heuristics to cluster by trace_id and instance patterns. Expect a PR with rules and rationale.
Carlos M.: For thresholds I'll prepare a short matrix: current threshold, observed distribution (p50/p90/p99), proposed tweak, rollback plan. Need query access to per-route latency histograms. @Evan L. can you grant the dashboard link?
Evan L.: Granting dashboard access to Carlos now. Also dropping the rough noise numbers here: [api_5xx] triggers: 310, unique_signatures: 18, fp_estimate: 62%; [db_conn] triggers: 87, fp_estimate: 45%; [cache_miss_flood] triggers: 123, fp_estimate: 53%.
Aisha Patel: For paging policy, proposal is: (1) move low-signal alerts to async email only with 24h dedupe window, (2) keep high-severity infra alerts paged, (3) add an escalation hold for noise-prone alerts while we tune. I'll draft a doc and link it here.
Ben K.: Quick question — do we have an owned list of alerts that are safe to silence for 24h? I can start with a candidate set from my sweep.
Carlos M.: I'll share a staging test plan — non-prod simulation to validate thresholds before prod push.
Evan L.: I posted sample queries and the alerts CSV in #eng-oncall-assets and linked them here: https://internal/eng-oncall/assets/1767777000. Ping me if access issues.
Aisha Patel: Nice. Action items recap: Ben -> dedupe PR by Tue, Carlos -> thresholds proposal by Tue, Aisha -> paging policy doc by Wed, Evan -> per-alert data (done) and dashboard access. We'll do a 30-min review Thu morning. :calendar:
Ben K.: Adding review slot to my calendar.
Carlos M.: Same.
Aisha Patel: Thanks everyone. If anyone spots any recurring pattern I missed, drop it here. :heart:
